title: Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Agriculture; not yet checked by a CBC Agriculture teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Make samples of an open seam and a plain seam by hand on cotton, then a pillow case or cushion cover. Count needles and pins in and out.

skills.key_step: The child names seams used in household items (plain seam, open seam, and others such as French seam) and says what each looks like and where it is used (pillow cases, cushion covers, bags, curtains).
representations: a pillow case turned inside out
steps: A seam joins two pieces of cloth.
Plain: turnings pressed together. Open: pressed apart.

board.do: Draw a seam with the turnings pressed flat on each side.

misconceptions.repair: Sew two pieces right sides together in a line of stitches: that is a plain seam.

misconceptions.ask: What does a French seam do?
misconceptions.repair: Show a French seam: the raw edges are hidden inside a second line of stitching.
Turn a pillow case inside out and find its seams.

listen_for: A seam that is not sewn
misconceptions.repair: Show an open seam pressed flat from the wrong side.

checks.question: Where is a seam used at home?
checks.answer: pillow cases, cushion covers, curtains, bags

skills.key_step: The child says how to make a seam: right sides together, pin and tack on the fitting line, stitch about 1.5 cm in, remove tacking, press open or to one side, neaten raw edges, then make a household item with seams.
steps: Right sides together; pin and tack.

board.do: Draw two pieces of cloth with patterned sides facing out.
Ask where the raw edges will be after sewing.

misconceptions.ask: Which sides of the cloth face each other when sewing a plain seam?
misconceptions.repair: Sew a sample wrong sides together and turn it: the raw edges show outside.

misconceptions.ask: How far from the edge is a seam stitched?
misconceptions.repair: Pull a seam stitched at the edge: the threads fray out.

misconceptions.ask: Why are the raw edges of a seam neatened?
misconceptions.repair: Wash an un-neatened sample several times.

misconceptions.ask: Why is a seam pressed after sewing?
misconceptions.repair: Compare a pressed and an unpressed seam on a cushion.

checks.question: Which sides face each other when sewing a seam?
